Case_10015/figure1.jpg.source_caption: Endometrial biopsy, hematoxylin and eosin stain (600 x magnification).

description.short_caption: Endometrial biopsy, hematoxylin and eosin stain at 600x magnification.
description.detailed_description: This histopathology image shows an endometrial biopsy stained with hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) at 600x magnification. The tissue contains inflammatory cells, including numerous macrophages and lymphocytes, with some multinucleated giant cells visible. A prominent circular structure resembling a fungal spore or yeast form is present, surrounded by inflammatory cells. The background shows stromal tissue with mild distortion.
visible_findings: inflammatory cells including macrophages and lymphocytes
prominent circular structure resembling a fungal spore or yeast

Case_10015/figure2.jpg.source_caption: Endometrial biopsy with acid-fast stain (1000 x magnification).

description.short_caption: Endometrial biopsy with acid-fast stain showing acid-fast bacilli.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a high-magnification (1000x) view of an endometrial biopsy stained with an acid-fast stain. The background tissue appears blue, while several slender, rod-shaped organisms stain bright red, consistent with acid-fast bacilli. The staining highlights the presence of mycobacterial organisms within the tissue.
